# Synthetic funder-source conflict

## Current guideline, dated 2027

Requests may range from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000. Only registered nonprofits may apply.

## Archived guideline, dated 2023

Requests may range from USD 10,000 to USD 100,000. Public agencies and nonprofits may apply.

The analysis must preserve both passages and apply the current guideline unless a primary source establishes otherwise.
